analogy.rationale: The annotated target PRKCA (PKC alpha) is a serine/threonine kinase, so PKC inhibitors should phenocopy the response most closely; other kinase inhibitors share downstream signaling but act on distinct nodes, and PRKCA is broadly expressed so a weak-to-moderate response is expected.
